audit.why: Level chart and phase text agree: Lux wins Level 1 on poke, Nautilus takes over from Level 2 onward once Dredge Line is online against her zero-mobility frame.

Spikes correctly key Level 2 all-in, Level 6 unstoppable Depth Charge chase, first item engage threshold, and late flank window — all grounded in Lux having no dash/blink and one long-cooldown Q as her only peel.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.early and dosFull[1].d never mention Lux's passive, Illumination — a real auto-attack-reset burst tell that telegraphs her combo.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags this as applicable-but-unmentioned: Lux's damaging spells charge Illumination, and her next auto detonates it for bonus magic damage. That auto-reset wind-up is a visible cue Nautilus can react to before the burst lands, and Titan's Wrath's shield (W) is the concrete tool that eats her E/Q chip while its damage-over-time punishes her for standing in autos.
audit.corrected: breakdown.early now names Illumination's proc as the wind-up cue; dosFull[1].d grounds the W-shield title in what Titan's Wrath actually does (shield + DoT) instead of the pasted tradeGood line.
